exec: pm.test("semua transaksi milik customer ini", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach((item) => pm.expect(item.customerId === pm.collectionVariables.get("customerId")).to.be.true));
pm.test("terbaru di atas", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length > 1) pm.expect(new Date(d[0].createdAt) >= new Date(d[1].createdAt)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("transaksi PAID dari folder 4 punya tiket", () => pm.expect(data.tickets.length).to.eql(data.quantity));
pm.test("semua PAID & event yang dipilih", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach((item) => pm.expect(item.status === "PAID" && item.eventId === pm.collectionVariables.get("eventId")).to.be.true));

pm.test("ada nama, jumlah tiket & total bayar", () => { const t = pm.response.json().data[0]; pm.expect(t.users.username).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(t.quantity).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(t).to.have.property("finalAmount"); });
